EXACT TEMPLATE NAMES AND FORMATS ### **Primary Template: {{cite tweet}}** **Official Syntax:** ```wikitext {{Cite tweet |user= |number= |title=}} ``` **Required Parameters:** - `|user=` - Twitter handle WITHOUT the @ symbol (e.g., \"Pigsonthewing\" not \"@Pigsonthewing\") - `|number=` - Tweet ID (the long numerical string from the tweet URL) - `|title=` - Full or partial content of the tweet **Important Optional Parameters:** - `|author=` OR `|last=` and `|first=` - Real name of the author (recommended when known) - `|author-link=` - Title of Wikipedia article about the author - `|date=` - Tweet publication date (optional for tweets after Nov 4, 2010; auto-calculated from tweet ID) - `|access-date=` - Date when the tweet was accessed - `|archive-url=` - URL of archived copy - `|archive-date=` - Date when archived - `|url-status=` - Set to \"live\" or \"dead\" - `|language=` - Language code if not English (e.g., \"fr\", \"es\") - `|location=` - Location from which tweet was sent - `|retweet=` - Name of person/organization who retweeted - `|quote=` - Relevant text quoted from the tweet - `|script-title=` - For non-Latin scripts (prefix with language code) - `|trans-title=` - English translation of foreign language tweets **Full Example from Documentation:** ```wikitext {{Cite tweet |author=Elon Musk |author-link=Elon Musk |user=elonmusk |number=743097337782763521 |title=Looks like thrust was low on 1 of 3 landing engines.
